description: Dispatch a crew to a job: name the technicians who are on the work. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Dispatching did not email or text the customer when this was exercised, and Housecall Pro's own record of what it sent shows nothing going out for it. That is not a promise of silence: your account's automations and notification settings can send on their own, whatever any single call does, and one account's configuration says nothing about another's. Every dispatch needs at least one technician - Housecall Pro rejects one that names nobody, and a request that names nobody is refused here rather than sent. This sets who is on the job's work. To put a crew on a dated visit, or to move one, book or change the appointment with hcp_schedule_job_appointment or hcp_update_job_appointment instead.

employee_ids.description: Technicians to dispatch (pro_... ids from hcp_list_employees). At least one is required.
